design.concept: A decision-first mobile board: pending expenses appear as large cards, each with a full-width status strip, who, category and a big amount. Tapping a card opens its own full scene where the outcome buttons (Approve / Reject) come first, the rejection reason sits right under them, and the facts are read afterwards.

views.purpose: The board of pending team expenses as a single column of cards, with load more, loading, error and empty states.
Full scene for one expense: identity, outcome buttons and reason first, then the facts (amount, date, category, description, resubmission, previous rejection reason). Back returns to the board.

design.decisions: Followed the decisionFirst template, not the defs' read-then-decide order: no table, only cards with a status strip (status tokens, not a small badge). The detail is a scene of the scene host (scenary mode with back), not a split. In the detail the decision organism is placed before the analysis organism. The reason field is always visible under the buttons because the page holds no state to open it on demand. Failures show above the buttons with a retry. Success replaces the outcome row with one line and the scene stays open. The search bar and PDF viewer were left out: the shared has no search/filter method and the rows have no proof field, and the page must not filter or invent data. Empty board has a large icon, one sentence and a reload action. Amounts and dates are shown from the row fields, nothing is computed.
